text.zh: 膝盖往两边打开，臀部慢慢往后坐
text.en: Spread your knees wide and slowly sit your hips back

text.zh: 前臂撑地，脚尖朝外，背放平。
text.en: Rest on your forearms, toes out, back flat.

text.zh: 保持不动，慢慢呼吸，每次呼气再放松一点。
text.en: Stay still, breathe slowly, and relax a little deeper each time you breathe out.

text.zh: 别来回颠，有拉伸感就够，别拉到疼。
text.en: Do not bounce; a clear stretch is enough, never pain.

commonErrors.zh: 硬压髋部追求更大幅度
commonErrors.en: Forcing your hips to go further.

cautions.zh: 膝盖下面垫软垫，膝盖不舒服就别再分开
cautions.en: Pad under your knees and stop widening if they feel uncomfortable.

cautions.zh: 大腿内侧疼时坐浅一点，别让别人帮你压
cautions.en: If your inner thighs hurt, sit back less, and never let someone push you down.
